book.modonomicon.demo.scholarship.first_: First page progression, unlocked by the scholarship entry.
The desk is set up, so the catalogue is unlocked. Pages after a stage stay hidden until the stage is complete.

This entry unlocked when the synthesis of the scholarship entry was completed.
The requirements of the next stage are listed at the bottom of this first page, that is the default display.
Each requirement gets a check mark once you have it. Complete them to unlock the catalogue.
The marker on this entry clears once you have read the sources shelf.
Craft a crafting table and collect any log.
book.modonomicon.demo.scholarship.name: Scholarship
book.modonomicon.demo.scholarship.none_p: You gathered an ink sac, so this page is visible. This is the hand-authored stage 1 of the requirements research.

The last stage is complete. Its requirements were the iron ingot and 5 paper of the requirements research.
The next entry, Bookbinding, is unlocked by this one.
Hand-authored stages with requirement pages, no requirements display.

This entry has no requirements display, so nothing is listed at the bottom of its pages.
Its research is hand-authored: the first stage needs an ink sac, the second needs an iron ingot and 5 paper.
The requirements pages below show the progress of each stage instead, and the pages after a stage stay hidden until it is complete.
Actions, research notes, rewards and manual completion.

Welcome to the scholar's notebook. This entry starts the storyline: it teaches you to take, make and study research notes, and rewards you with insight.
Finish the synthesis to unlock the next entry, Setting up the desk. Each entry lists what is missing for the next one at the bottom of its page.
The requirements of the current stage are listed at the bottom of this page.

Some requirements have an action. Click the icon to perform it, the tooltip lists its costs.
Observations cost one paper and grant experience, which is shown as a reward row once the stage is done.
Pay one paper to record your observations.
Hold two iron ingots and complete it by hand. The Iron Ingot row counts what you hold, the stage consumes it on completion.
Take a blank note, make a completed note from it with an ink sac, then study the completed note in the air.

The last stage is completed by hand with the Complete button of the stage line.
Its cost, two iron ingots, is listed as an Iron Ingot row that counts the iron you hold, and it is consumed on completion.
The button is enabled once you hold enough, before that its tooltip says what is missing.
Completing it grants an emerald and runs a function.

The second row of Transcription is done once you craft a completed research note. Craft the blank note together with an ink sac, as the recipe on the next page shows.
Vanilla recipes cannot check the marker of an item, so the recipe also accepts plain paper in place of the blank note.
A real mod would use its own item or a machine for this step.

The third row of Transcription is done once you use a completed note in the air to study it. The note is consumed, and the rewards are granted once the stage completes.
Using a blank note does nothing, so the note must be completed first.

The first row of Transcription has an action that hands out a blank research note.
It costs one paper and wears down your shears. You can take a note even while you carry one.
The row is ticked once you have taken a note, but the action stays clickable, so you can take more notes later.
All three rows of Transcription are grouped under the Knowledge category of the requirements, so they are listed together.
book.modonomicon.demo.scholarship.placed: Placed requirements pages between the content.

Both stages are complete, and every requirements page of this entry shows its requirements as done.
The next entry, Cross-reference, is unlocked by this one, and it asks for an advancement.

The next page is a requirements page. It lists what the first stage needs, and it is placed here, not at the bottom of a page.
Requirements pages are never hidden, so they keep showing your progress after a stage is complete.
The marker of this entry clears once you have crafted a writable book.

You have an iron ingot, so this page is unlocked. The requirements page before it now shows the first stage with check marks.
The requirements page below shows the stage that comes next.
book.modonomicon.demo.scholarship.source: Ungated value collector: viewing it counts a source.

This shelf is always open. Viewing it once counts as one source consulted, the value collector of the research.
The catalogue asks for one consulted source before it can be completed.
book.modonomicon.demo.scholarship.stage_: Bind writable books to unlock each page.

This entry demonstrates research stages. Each page unlocks as you complete a stage by binding writable books, which needs ink.
The requirements page below shows the stage that is next, with its progress.

You bound your first writable book and completed stage 1.
Bind 2 more (3 total) to unlock the next stage.

Stage 2 is done. You have bound 3 writable books.
Bind 2 more (5 total) to reach the final stage.
All research stages have been completed. The bound volume is finished, and this last page only shows once the final stage is complete.
book.modonomicon.demo.scholarship.traili: Both stages are complete, so the index is unlocked. Once the last stage is done, the trailing page only lists completed requirements.
Trailing page progression with value requirements.

The requirements of this entry are listed on a trailing page after the last page of the entry. Flip past the end of the entry to see them.
The first stage counts the paper you pick up, the second counts the sources you consulted on the shelf. The progress of each is shown as a bar.
Read the sources shelf of this category.
